summary: Deprecate and remove old versioning client calls that were part of a previous pre-GA versioning API. This is a tracking issue for coordinating deprecation across all Temporal SDKs.
userImpact: Users will need to migrate away from deprecated versioning client calls across all SDKs in a coordinated deprecation timeline.
proposedFix: Deprecate old versioning client calls in all SDKs (Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, .NET, Ruby, Rust, PHP) and Temporal CLI, followed by eventual removal.
resolutionDetails: Issue closed after coordinating deprecation tracking across all SDK repositories.
keyQuote: A previous incarnation of versioning that never reached GA put calls on all clients that now need to be deprecated and eventually removed.
